title: Crediting and Paying Out Certificate of Deposit Interest
content:
Accrued interest on a certificate is credited on the dates the tier publishes, and it is then dealt with in the way the owner has chosen from the dispositions the tier offers.

## 1. Crediting dates and dispositions by tier

| Tier | Interest is credited | Dispositions the tier offers |
|---|---|---|
| 6-Month Certificate | at maturity | compounded into the certificate |
| 11-Month No-Penalty Certificate | monthly | compounded into the certificate; paid to a Piedmont Crescent checking account; paid to a Piedmont Crescent savings or money market account |
| 12-Month Certificate | monthly | compounded into the certificate; paid to a Piedmont Crescent checking account; paid to a Piedmont Crescent savings or money market account |
| 18-Month Bump-Up Certificate | monthly | compounded into the certificate; paid to a Piedmont Crescent checking account; paid to a Piedmont Crescent savings or money market account |
| 36-Month Certificate | monthly | compounded into the certificate; paid to a Piedmont Crescent checking account; paid to a Piedmont Crescent savings or money market account |
| 60-Month Certificate | monthly | compounded into the certificate; paid to a Piedmont Crescent checking account; paid to a Piedmont Crescent savings or money market account |

The 6-Month Certificate is the one tier of the Certificates of Deposit line that credits once only, at maturity, and the one tier that offers no disposition other than compounding.

## 2. Ways proceeds may be paid

Every tier of the Certificates of Deposit line pays maturity or withdrawal proceeds in the same three ways: to a Piedmont Crescent checking account, to a Piedmont Crescent savings or money market account, or by an official check drawn by the bank.

| Tier | Ways proceeds may be paid |
|---|---|
| 6-Month Certificate | checking, savings, official check |
| 11-Month No-Penalty Certificate | checking, savings, official check |
| 12-Month Certificate | checking, savings, official check |
| 18-Month Bump-Up Certificate | checking, savings, official check |
| 36-Month Certificate | checking, savings, official check |
| 60-Month Certificate | checking, savings, official check |

## 3. Basis Q&A

**On which tiers may an owner ask for the interest to be sent to another account?** On the five tiers that credit monthly. An owner of a 6-Month Certificate may not, because that tier offers compounding alone.

**Does the way proceeds are paid depend on the tier?** No. The three ways are open on every tier of the line, and the choice is a matter of where the owner wants the money, not of which certificate they hold.
